question: Should Crabline retain its published Node 22 support contract, or intentionally move the project runtime baseline to Node 26?
rationale: A dependency-only PR cannot safely choose the product runtime floor because the manifest currently promises Node 22 compatibility while Node 26 type declarations describe a newer API surface.

options.title: Retain Node 22 support
options.body: Keep a Node 22-compatible `@types/node` version and merge only an update that preserves the existing runtime contract.

options.title: Adopt Node 26 deliberately
options.body: Sponsor a coordinated baseline change that raises engines and CI coverage, documents upgrade impact, and verifies the project under Node 26.

recommendation.title: Retain Node 22 support
recommendation.body: Keep a Node 22-compatible `@types/node` version and merge only an update that preserves the existing runtime contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the repository's supported-runtime policy, and no concrete feature-history owner was available in the supplied evidence.
